name: The National Autism Society of Malaysia (NASOM)
legalName: The National Autism Society of Malaysia
summary: Runs lifelong education, intervention and support services for autistic people, from early childhood to adulthood, and their families.
impact: 444 students enrolled as of 31 December 2024 (Annual Report 2024)
Total income RM2,848,588 in FY2024 (Annual Report 2024)
beneficiaries: Autistic children, young people and adults, and their families

organisation.founders: A group of parents and professionals (no individuals named); registered 3 March 1987 as a national charity
organisation.leadership: Mohd Nazrul Mohd Amin (President); Julian Wong Ming Vui (Chairman); Dr. Nursuriati Jamil (Vice Chairman); Cason Ong Tzse Chun (Secretary); Ong Shu Pei (Treasurer)
